preconditions.description: The input integer n must be a positive integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length exactly n and consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output stdout must be the original word that, when encoded by Polycarp's method, produces the input string s.
